inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: The contribution-positioning text names the comparison set, states the distinct unit of contribution, labels adaptations versus synthesis, and makes no unsupported global novelty claim.

operationalization.fully_addressed: The manuscript names the closest certificate-methods and proof-carrying computational comparison set, identifies the article's distinct unit of contribution, explicitly distinguishes adapted elements from synthesized elements, and confines novelty language to what the stated comparison supports.
operationalization.partially_addressed: The manuscript supplies a genuine comparison or contribution distinction, but at least one required element remains missing or unresolved: a named comparison set, the distinct contribution unit, adaptation-versus-synthesis labeling, or a bounded and supported novelty statement.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: Relative to the original manuscript, the contribution-positioning surface broadens or strengthens an unsupported global novelty claim, further obscures the comparison basis, or more strongly collapses adaptation and synthesis into an undifferentiated contribution claim.

operationalization.fully_addressed: A reader can understand the main scholarly method without project-internal phase, reviewer-role, checkpoint, or route vocabulary, and every retained workflow-history statement is explicitly separated and labeled as provenance rather than as part of the scientific method.

inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: Every artifact invoked as an audit basis has a stable locator, version or content digest, access condition, and explicit claim-surface relationship, or the auditability claim is narrowed to what readers can actually inspect.

operationalization.fully_addressed: For every artifact invoked as an audit basis, the manuscript supplies a stable reader-resolvable locator, a version or content digest, an access condition, and an explicit relationship to the manuscript claim surface; alternatively, each auditability statement is narrowed so that it covers only material readers can actually inspect.
operationalization.partially_addressed: Some invoked artifacts receive the required locator, version-or-digest, access, and claim-surface metadata, or some auditability language is narrowed, but at least one invoked audit basis remains inaccessible, incompletely identified, or covered by a broader auditability claim than readers can verify.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: Relative to the original manuscript, auditability is asserted for more artifacts or in stronger terms without the required locator, version-or-digest, access, and claim-surface metadata, or existing reader-inspectability information is removed or made less resolvable.

inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: The reported corpus counts replay from the disclosed row-level ledger, and the final 22 admitted identifiers are hash-linked to the evidence matrix without implying a broader search than was executed.

operationalization.fully_addressed: The disclosed search-and-screening ledger records the executed sources or interfaces, dates, exact queries, raw identifiers, deduplication rules, and every row-level inclusion or exclusion decision needed to reproduce the reported corpus counts; the final 22 admitted identifiers are content-hash-linked to the evidence matrix, and the stated search scope does not exceed the executed search.
operationalization.partially_addressed: The manuscript or linked ledger provides genuine row-level search or screening evidence, but an omitted query, run field, deduplication rule, decision row, corpus-count reconciliation, or hash link prevents complete replay, or the stated scope remains broader than the disclosed execution.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: Relative to the original manuscript, the corpus accounting becomes less replayable, an existing query, run, deduplication, screening, identifier, or hash-link disclosure is weakened or removed, or the search-scope claim is expanded beyond the execution evidenced by the ledger.

operationalization.fully_addressed: Every decision-bearing source-role claim follows one of the two permitted paths: it provides an exact passage, theorem, page, section, or paragraph locator together with the applicable hypotheses and prohibited transfers, or it is explicitly narrowed and continues to carry an INCONCLUSIVE claim-to-passage status.
operationalization.partially_addressed: At least one decision-bearing source-role claim gains a valid locator with its hypothesis and transfer boundaries, or is narrowed with INCONCLUSIVE retained, but one or more such claims still lack a complete permitted path.
